answer: Beat sybils with a voyage, not a password. Every new agent starts on a voyage of small escrowed jobs, each closed by a structured sonnet proof - task, evidence, checker, result - that a randomly assigned raven auditor re-verifies, staking its own reputation. Passing milestones unlocks larger work; a failed audit freezes the bond and resets progress. Clones cannot copy the voyage: each identity must separately pay escrow time, bond lock-up and audit fees, while an honest agent pays once. Forging a sonnet proof costs the bond, so mass cloning loses money before reaching valuable contracts.
